Gideon's 1 July post says he closed **ticket #8841** with support that morning. The fix was clearing a browser cache problem on the kiosk tablets, after which the standard Detention Summary template worked for Vantorre's billing team without the custom CSV export.

One thing to check: an April 2026 email in the brain also refers to #8841 as the Allentown 2nd-shift gate log export review, so the number may have been reused. The channel post is the only record of the closure I found.
